meta.title: ArrrStudio — Roblox & web systems studio from Bandung
meta.description: ArrrStudio builds ready-to-ship Roblox kits, creator tools and custom websites. Founded by Sigit Hardianto in Bandung, Indonesia.

hero.title: Roblox and web systems that work on day one.
hero.lead: ArrrStudio designs Roblox game kits, creator tools and custom websites. Every release ships complete: clean code, curated UI and installation docs.
hero.sceneLabel: The ArrrStudio A mark in 3D: silver chrome with a maroon star

about.label: About
about.title: What is ArrrStudio
body: ArrrStudio is a development studio focused on one thing: systems that just run. Roblox game owners buy a kit, drop it into their place, and it plugs into the DataStore, group ranks, gamepasses and leaderstats they already use.
Beyond Roblox, the same studio builds websites, admin panels and apps for clients — held to the same design and security standards.

principles.title: Ship-ready
principles.text: Kits arrive as complete, tested systems — not loose scripts you have to assemble yourself.

principles.title: Curated
principles.text: UI is built on design tokens, responsive on PC and mobile, with nothing that looks like a template.

principles.title: Built to last
principles.text: Connections are cleaned up, per-player data is protected and server load is budgeted from the start.

philosophy.label: Philosophy
philosophy.title: From an in-game name to a studio name.
story: “Arrr” is the name Sigit Hardianto plays under. There was never a plan to start a studio — these systems were built for his own use in Roblox.
Then other creators wanted them too. One kit became two, then a catalog. The in-game name came along as it was, and ArrrStudio was born.
To this day ArrrStudio is run by one person: a solo developer who designs, codes, tests and supports every release himself.
philosophy.quote: It was never meant to be built. It got built anyway.

name.playerText: Sigit’s name in-game — an identity used long before there was a studio.
name.studioText: Where systems once built for personal use are released for every creator.

values.title: Built because it’s used
values.text: Every system starts from a real need in his own games, not as a showpiece.

values.title: One person, one standard
values.text: Design, code, testing and support come from one pair of hands — nothing gets lost in handoffs.

values.title: Grown by request
values.text: The catalog grows because creators ask for it, not because of a grand plan.

founder.label: Founder
founder.bio: Sigit Hardianto — known in-game as “Arrr” — founded ArrrStudio in Bandung and runs it as a solo developer. His background is enterprise web development (Vue.js, .NET, Laravel), carried into Roblox: modular architecture, safe data and UI treated as a product.

ecosystem.label: Ecosystem
ecosystem.title: Three doors, one studio.
ecosystem.lead: Each ArrrStudio service has its own home. Pick the one you need.

store.name: Arrveil.store
store.text: Digital marketplace: Roblox kits & assets, Robux, game accounts and premium subscriptions. Pay straight to the store's QRIS, and every order is tracked through to proof of delivery.

license.name: ArrStudio License
license.text: License portal for premium kits. The key goes into the kit's Config module and is verified automatically when the Roblox server starts.

converter.name: ARRR Studio Bypass
converter.text: Roblox creator tools on web and desktop: YouTube to Roblox-ready audio, panoramas to 6-sided Skyboxes, background removal, image upscaling and a 10-layer Luau obfuscator.
